data.name: National Volley
data.detailed_description:
In-game text is currently available in Japanese only.

Take Japan to the Top

Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team. Select and develop players, then lead your team into international competition.

Discover promising talent from domestic leagues, schools, and among Japanese players competing overseas. Train them into a winning team, analyze your opponents, and decide your squad and tactics.

Will you focus on winning now, or invest in developing the next generation?

Keep making choices as you pursue the top of the world.

Select and Develop a 14-Player Squad

  • Find national-team candidates from domestic leagues and among promising young players

  • Use team training and individual coaching to develop strengths and cover weaknesses

  • Analyze opposing teams and select your squad for international competition

Watch the Results of Your Training Play Out in 3D

Player attributes and team selection shape every serve, receive, set, spike, and block.

Watch the players you developed take on powerful teams from around the world, one rally at a time.

You can switch viewing styles during a match.

  • Full Match — Follow every rally in 3D

  • Digest — Focus on the score and key moments

  • Closing Stages — Move quickly through the early game and start watching from the decisive moments

Start a Match Right Away

Quick Match lets you choose two of 16 national teams and start playing immediately.

In Coach Mode, choose your starting lineup and rotation, then set your serving, attacking, and blocking approaches. During the match, use timeouts and substitutions to lead your team from the bench.

A National Team That Changes Over Time

Players develop, grow older, and eventually leave the national team. Bring in new talent, navigate generational change, and build your own history with Japan.

data.short_description: Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team in this management sim. Discover promising players, select and train your squad, and pursue the world title. Watch the team you built take the court in fully simulated 3D matches. Japanese language only.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics with WebGL 2.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible graphics with WebGL 2.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
